state:
`Core\Request::method` has all its proofs: `about.md`, three examples, an attack
(`tests/hostile/core/Request/method/`, a `CONNECT` request thrown 100000 times and then kept
until the memory limit), a bench (0 allocations), and the Rust test
`method_reports_get_for_a_head_request_and_is_head_carries_the_truth` now carries its
`covers:` marker. Its card in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs` is in the plain voice.

The `Core\Json` figures went stale when `decode_fields` gained its stack check, and are
re-measured, so `dossier-core-json` is green again.

`Core\Request::mount` cannot have examples yet: a `.nvsr` request file has no section for a
mount (`crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs`'s module doc lists every section), so a proof run
always answers the door that strips nothing, `""` and no captures. `nvs run --request`
is what the proof runner calls (`tools/nv/proofs/run.ts:190`).

next.title: the dossier
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs`, the `nvs run --request` reader in `nvs-cli`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs`.

items.text: **A `.nvsr` file can name a mount** — a `--MOUNT--` section (prefix, then one capture per line) that `nvs run --request` carries to `Core\Request::mount` the way the server's door does, `nvs_server::mount::carry` (`rule:routing/a-request-reads-its-mount`). The parser is `crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs:180` and the CLI's reading of it is tested at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:3359`.

**`Core\Request::mount`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`); the Rust test after `method_reports_get_for_a_head_request_and_is_head_carries_the_truth` asserts both sides of the mount and only needs its `covers:` marker. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs:404`

backlog: The rest of the `Core\Request` roster in `data/goals/core-request-2-2.json`'s dossier check: `path`, `post`, `postAs`, `query`, `queryAs`, `route`, `scheme` — `bun nv proofs --owed`.

`tests/hostile/core/Json/decode/01-deep-large-and-broken-documents.nvs` ended with exit 253 on the proofs' recording run and 0 on the judged run; both count as a pass, but the runner now runs it every time until they agree — `tools/nv/proofs/run.ts`.
